rows.notes: The cited document is a systematic review (narrative synthesis of 148 records on climate change impacts on coffee), not a primary study; Q1 is 'no'. It reports no own data on drip or sensor-based irrigation. Irrigation appears only as a search keyword (Table 2) and in passing references to irrigation conditions in CO2 metabolomics work by others; the review does not evaluate drip irrigation as a drought-adaptation or risk-management measure.
